title: Excellent start
body:
I really struggle to find support for myself- I have suspected ADHD but getting a diagnosis or treatment where I live has a long waiting list. I like that this planner and coach seems to tick like my brain does. Sometimes I find other planner hard work, or not aligned with my needs. I’ve only used this for one day but it seems promising.
I am also surprised an app of this quality is totally free- I hope it stays like this
author: Mac7X

title: Can neither log in nor create an account
body: Have been using for weeks and found it helpful. It now wants me to log in or create an account but won’t let me. In the meantime it keeps sending me prompts that I can’t respond to. Frustrated!
author: ElizaJo25

title: Just the best start to a day and a week
body:
Having woken up at 4:30am again, with my brain not switching off about work, it’s been a relief to start making a meaningful plan for my day, my weak and those little insites and focus points now all feel so manageable and achievable, rather than overwhelming. 
I love the conversation style and how quickly and efficiently I can set goals and checkins with insights that really resonate. 
Thanks for the app, can’t wait to make it my best habit and life hack!
author: Carmel141

title: Actually changed my life
body: I never leave app reviews but I feel like it’s well deserved. I felt like I could never maintain routines and calendars helped but were easy to forget. The premise of the app is simple but clever - it’s a time to reflect everyday and prompts me to make minor changes that make a big impact. Because it tracks my progress, I feel like I can really focus on a few things at a time instead of bursts of trying to do everything and then failing after a week. It has a few bugs but it’s part of growing pains and I’m happy to overlook them for the overall change it’s brought in my life
author: Lavanya S.

title: Unusable keyboard
body:
I like the premise of the app, but it’s impossible to get past the first stage. The keyboard is simply unusable. 

I’d like to try the rest of the app, and hope it’s of a higher quality than my first impression. 

Won’t be returning until improvements are made.
author: k9319

title: Fantastic! Intuitive, visual and interactive.
body: Chat integration works very well - asks relevant questions about your goals, identifies challenges, and updates your workflow contextually and accurately. Very impressed!
author: Dr M Luong

title: Surprisingly comforting and helpful!
body: Was honestly blown away by how much having acknowledgement of how much is on my plate and a structure to my priorities day to day has helped me not only accomplish my goals but actually feel that sense of accomplishment as a result. Previously I’d do a million things but not everything on my to do list and feel like im failing. It’s so nice to actually take a moment and really establish what I want to do and break it down so it’s doable, then feel good that I followed my intention. There’s a few bugs / kinks to work out but overall a very smooth delightful lovingly made app. Thank you for helping me ❤️
author: Ltraino

title: Only got to the first stage and it’s unusable
body:
Only as far as step 1 - adding in meaningful life events. Trying to type these events in and it’s extremely buggy. 
Deleting letters and full words as I’m trying to type, going back to random spaces earlier in sentence/paragraph and inserting letters in random places when trying to type out a sentence, not typing letters when I press them, generally completely unusable and extremely frustrating to not even be able to do the simplest task of typing?! Nothing is workable if you can’t even type. 

Have tried to persevere so I can at least get to the next stage to see if the rest of it works, but it’s impossible. Maybe if this very basic function is sorted, I would give it another go, but it’s a bad first impression I’m afraid.
author: ktaw567

title: Very helpful to see it all in black and white as I didn’t realise there was so much on my plate
body:
I do love AI so this is ideal for me. I really didn’t realise how much I was piling on myself-emotionally and physically.
Now I can see a clearer way forward. Thank you!!
author: Julie Rosie 62
